description: Read one stored evaluation: its status, total score, grade and pass/fail, each criterion's score, confidence, probabilities and rationale, and any human tasks still pending. Use it to re-read a result or to see one entry of a `compare` ranking in full. It judges nothing.

id.description: Evaluation id, as returned by `evaluate` (`id`) or `compare` (`evaluationId`).

name: get_evaluation
title: Get evaluation
